decisions.reason: Having survived the initial learning period and fitting the firm's data-driven infrastructure direction, this close-to-core software is likely at or near aspiration and can be supported by existing software teams.

It is still close to the established offer, but its lower visibility and possible overlap with other data products make it a more plausible candidate for later consolidation if results fall short of aspiration.

This hardware add-on is less central to the firm's digital trajectory, yet as a complementary component in integrated infrastructure projects it can still be retained while industry growth and organisational slack persist.

As a web- and data-oriented automation software offer closely aligned with the firm's strategic direction, it is the kind of product a medium German infrastructure machinery firm would usually continue unless performance clearly disappoints.
